veldt_solar_executive_team.name: Veldt Solar executive team
veldt_solar_executive_team.persona_brief:
You are Veldt Solar executive team.
The executive team (CEO, CFO, head of product, and other relevant executives) will meet at the quarterly review to decide on the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to utility-scale; the CEO is publicly neutral. The team is aware of the pilot's 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

pilot_team.name: Pilot team
pilot_team.persona_brief:
You are Pilot team.
The pilot team is awaiting the executive team's decision on whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. They have no direct influence on the decision.

resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2026-10-12T18:00:00+02:00 (end of the same week), the executive team formally decided to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot AND communicated that decision to the pilot team. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
